title: Comparison of Proposal Unit Volumes and Warranty Periods
body:
Both proposals outline equipment, installation, delivery, and warranty terms. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31)

Proposal one specifies equipment for 2500 units. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31)

Proposal two specifies equipment for 3100 units. [Second proposal](/page/89bb2932-f31b-400d-b312-f971e524a6f0)

The installation volume is 500 units in each proposal. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31) [Second proposal](/page/89bb2932-f31b-400d-b312-f971e524a6f0)

The total ordered units amount to 3000 in the first proposal. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31)

The total ordered units amount to 3600 in the second proposal. [Second proposal](/page/89bb2932-f31b-400d-b312-f971e524a6f0)

Delivery timelines differ, with the first proposal targeting two weeks and the second targeting four weeks. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31) [Second proposal](/page/89bb2932-f31b-400d-b312-f971e524a6f0)

Warranty periods also differ, with the first offering one year of warranty and the second offering two years. [First proposal](/page/51f1fcc0-a67b-45c5-b8af-0c356e65ef31) [Second proposal](/page/89bb2932-f31b-400d-b312-f971e524a6f0)
